misconceptions.description: Treating a free or zero-price tier as having no cost of ownership
misconceptions.trigger: learner adopts a tool because the headline price is zero
misconceptions.feedback: Free is a price, not a total cost. Surface training time, device and storage needs, feature-gated upgrades, and what happens when the free tier ends.

misconceptions.description: Comparing only the annual license price and ignoring recurring teacher time and infrastructure
misconceptions.trigger: learner ranks options on sticker price alone
misconceptions.feedback: Add the recurring human time and infrastructure to the price. The cheaper sticker can be the costlier tool to sustain.

misconceptions.description: Treating an AI-generated cost projection as the official budget figure without checking its assumptions
misconceptions.trigger: learner forwards an AI multi-year total without verifying inputs
misconceptions.feedback: An AI estimate is only as good as its assumptions. Verify each input against the real contract and local enrollment before relying on it.

misconceptions.description: Assuming a fully funded first year means the adoption is sustainable
misconceptions.trigger: learner judges sustainability from year-one experience while a grant covers the cost
misconceptions.feedback: Plan past year one: who pays at renewal, can you export your data, and what does it cost to leave. That is the sustainability question.
